title: Step 63-A canonical handoff, live guard and Cart/Checkout scope freeze
description: Documentation/governance-only Stage A for Step 63. Verify the terminal Step 62 handoff on live main, freeze Cart & Checkout Frontend scope, record current Storefront placeholder state and authoritative backend/OpenAPI readiness, register the A-I execution plan and acceptance gates, and keep runtime/API/database/dependency mutation forbidden until Stage A completes protected merge and exact-SHA postmerge verification.

dependencies.name: Compare & Wishlist final canonical closure and final audit
dependencies.evidence: PR #303 merged Step 62 final audit on live main; HOS-66 is Done; Step 62 runtime/browser/CodeQL evidence remains PASS and no open PR exists.

evidence.graph_tooling_state: Canonical Graphify tooling exists; live local graph artifact is repository-local/ignored and is not exposed through the GitHub connector. Runtime stages require FRESH/PASS local graph health before mutation.

discovery.storefront_routes: /cart, /checkout/identity, /checkout/address, /checkout/delivery, /checkout/review, /payment/return and /order/:orderNumber/outcome are registered but currently RoutePlaceholder screens targeted to Step 63.
discovery.cart_backend: Canonical OpenAPI provides POST /cart, GET /cart/{id}, POST/PATCH/DELETE cart items, POST /cart/{id}/quote, GET /customer/cart, POST /customer/cart/access and POST /customer/cart/merge.
discovery.checkout_backend: Canonical OpenAPI provides POST /checkout/{id}/reserve and POST /checkout/{id}/order with checkout access-token boundaries and required idempotency.
discovery.address_delivery: Canonical OpenAPI provides customer-owned address operations and GET /shipping-methods.
discovery.payment_backend: Canonical OpenAPI provides POST /orders/{order_number}/payments with required Idempotency-Key, POST /payments/{payment_id}/verify, GET /orders/{order_number}/payments/{payment_id} and GET /payments/{payment_id}/status.
discovery.design_drift: Step-55 wireframe operation labels use older customer-prefixed payment route names in places. Step 63 must bind to current canonical OpenAPI operationIds/paths rather than legacy design labels.
discovery.migration_need: No Stage-A evidence requires a new database migration.
discovery.dependency_need: No Stage-A evidence requires a new dependency.

stages.goal: Canonical handoff, live guard, discovery and Cart/Checkout scope freeze
Backend/OpenAPI Cart, Checkout, Address, Shipping and Payment contract readiness
Shared Storefront Cart/Checkout data, token and authoritative state foundation
Production Cart flow, quantity mutation, quote refresh and guest/customer cart recovery
Checkout identity and customer-owned address flow
Delivery selection, authoritative quote, reservation, review and idempotent order submission
Payment handoff, return verification, status recovery and order outcome flow
RTL, accessibility, responsive, loading/empty/error/offline hardening and integrated browser acceptance
Final canonical verification, documentation reconciliation and Step 64 handoff

acceptance_criteria.description: Live main, Step 62 terminal closure/final audit, Current State, Roadmap, open PRs, HOS-67 and relevant Lock state are inspected; Step 63 is proven NEXT / NOT_STARTED at the Stage-A baseline.
Step 63 A-I plan and exact Cart/Checkout IN boundary are frozen; Account/After-Sales remains Step 64, Wholesale Step 65 and Content/SEO Step 66.

Existing Storefront Step-63 routes are verified as placeholders while canonical backend/OpenAPI readiness for cart, quote, reserve, order, cart merge/access, addresses, shipping methods and payment status/verify is recorded.
Legacy Step-55 payment endpoint labels are treated as design history only when they differ from current canonical OpenAPI; Stage 63 implementation must consume current generated/OpenAPI contracts.
Persian fa-IR RTL, integer Toman, no Wallet, no brown palette, backend authority, accessibility, responsive behavior, safe auth/token handling and fail-closed recovery remain binding.
Stage 63-A is documentation/governance-only; no runtime, API, OpenAPI, DB, migration, dependency, permission or business-rule mutation is introduced.

Before any Stage 63 runtime mutation, local Graphify health must be FRESH/PASS and the applicable query/path/explain evidence must be recorded because the live graph artifact is not exposed through the GitHub connector.

Canonical completion of 63-A requires exact-head verification, Phase A and Merge Policy PASS, artifact-bound REVIEW/LOCK evidence, protected merge and exact-SHA postmerge verification before 63-B may mutate runtime/API.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 63-A is MEDIUM risk. Direct-main write and raw merge are prohibited. Step 63-B runtime/API mutation is forbidden until 63-A protected transport, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release are complete.
